prompts.label: Template prompt
prompts.text: One to three reference photos, one character each: a person, a pet or a toy. Keep every face, hairstyle, body, fur and outfit exactly as photographed and never swap them. Golden-hour sunset over a wide, empty gas station parking lot, trucks parked far in the background, two cars side by side with their doors flung open. Shot 1: the first character stands alone in the middle of the lot and breaks into a loose, bouncy dance, shoulders rolling, then throws both arms high. Shot 2: handheld fisheye selfie â the next character holds the camera at arm's length, grins and dances into the lens. Shot 3: a character leans out of an open car door, looks around, then climbs out smiling and joins in. Shot 4: wide shot of everyone dancing together by the cars. With only one photo, that one character plays every shot. Wide-angle action-camera look, warm low sun, quick cuts on the beat, vertical video. Upbeat dance-pop music in the audio. No other people, no text, no logos on the cars or the station, no watermark.

prompts.label: Gas Station Trend AI â a panda dances at the pumps
prompts.text: One reference photo of a pet or a stuffed animal; keep its fur colour, markings and face exactly as photographed. Bright daytime at a gas station forecourt. Shot 1: standing upright on its hind legs beside a yellow sports car with no badges, it holds the camera at arm's length in a fisheye selfie and waves a paw. Shot 2: under the pump canopy it dances, bouncing side to side with both paws up, then steps toward the camera and wiggles its shoulders. Real animal anatomy: paws, never human hands. Wide-angle handheld look, quick cuts on the beat, vertical video. Upbeat dance-pop music in the audio. No people, no text, no station or car logos, no watermark.
